autoHideDuration.name: Auto Hide Duration
autoHideDuration.description: The number of milliseconds to wait before automatically calling the onClose function.

disableWindowBlurListener.name: Disable Window Blur Listener
disableWindowBlurListener.description: If true, the autoHideDuration timer will expire even if the window is not focused.

open.name: Open
open.description: If true, the component is shown.
